selection_rationale: Highest near-term feasibility and reproducibility for a five-page CNSM short paper; directly addresses a clear unresolved question (benchmark contamination/construct validity) with strong evidence support and manageable, well-scoped required repairs (ethical/provenance controls, heuristic validation, reproducible scripts).
unresolved_uncertainties: True overlap with proprietary LLM training corpora remains probabilistic due to lack of authoritative training manifests.
Contamination-detection heuristics' false-positive/false-negative rates under diverse NetOps tasks are uncertain until manual spot checks are performed.
Legal/reputational risk when reporting provenance findings—scope of redaction required is uncertain and may constrain disclosure detail.
required_repairs_before_preregistration: Formally define and justify contamination-detection heuristics and numeric thresholds (exact-match, fuzzy n-gram overlap) and preregister them.
Design and document a manual spot-check protocol to estimate FP/FN rates for the heuristics; include planned sample sizes and sampling procedure.
Specify a conservative responsible-disclosure policy for provenance findings; commit to redaction rules and non-defamatory reporting (what will be published vs. privately disclosed).
Prepare and freeze reproducible code/scripts, random seeds, dataset lists, and evaluation pipeline (containerized runner or CI artifacts) and publish hashes prior to preregistration.
Enumerate exact datasets to be audited and evidence sources; preregister inclusion/exclusion rules and any realism-adjustment transformations to avoid post-hoc changes.
